---
title: Tidy Data
categories: [tidy-data, data-wrangling, lecture, intermediate]
description: "Tidy data principles, data normalization, relational data models, primary/foreign keys, and table joins."
---

:::{.callout-learning}

After completing this session, you will be able to:

-   Appreciate general concepts around representing the real world in data form
-   Describe the three principles of tidy data in terms of variables, observations, and values
-   Identify common violations of tidy data principles and how to fix them
-   Understand the concept of data normalization and how it supports efficient data modeling
-   Confidently join information across separate but related tables
:::
